	**खो-खो** एक पारंपरिक **भारतीय** स्पर्श खेल है जिसके लिए उच्च स्तर की **चपलता (agility)**, **गति (speed)** और **सहनशक्ति (stamina)** की आवश्यकता होती है। खेल के दौरान आवश्यक विस्फोटक गतिविधियों के लिए मांसपेशियों को तैयार करने के लिए एक विशिष्ट प्रारम्भिक व्यायाम महत्वपूर्ण है।
	**मेंढक कूद (कथन I)**: यह एक प्लाईओमेट्रिक व्यायाम है जहाँ व्यक्ति गहरे स्क्वाट की स्थिति से आगे की ओर कूदता है। यह विशेष रूप से जांघ के अग्रभाग की मांसपेशियों, जांघ के पश्चभाग की मांसपेशियों तथा पिंडली की मांसपेशियों को सशक्त बनाता है, जिससे अचानक तेज़ दौड़ लगाने और प्रतिद्वंद्वी का पीछा करने के लिए आवश्यक विस्फोटक शक्ति विकसित होती है। ***इसलिए, कथन I सही है।***
	**टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी दौड़ (कथन II)**: इस व्यायाम में तेजी से दिशा बदलते हुए दौड़ना शामिल है। चूंकि **खो-खो** खिलाड़ियों को बैठे हुए साथियों के बीच से गुजरना होता है और विरोधियों से बचना होता है, इसलिए टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी दौड़ सीधे तौर पर **पार्श्व चपलता (lateral agility)** और **समन्वय (coordination)** में सुधार करती है। ***इसलिए, कथन II सही है।***
	**खो-खो** के लिए एक विशिष्ट वार्म-अप आमतौर पर **15 से 20 मिनट** तक चलता है और स्थि-मांसपेशीय तंत्र की चोटें** (musculoskeletal injuries)** को रोकने के लिए शरीर की सामान्य गतिविधियों से खेल-विशिष्ट अभ्यासों में परिवर्तित होता है।
	**मेंढक कूद** और टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी दौड़ दोनों करके, एक एथलीट यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि उनका **तंत्रिका-मांसपेशीय तंत्र****(neuromuscular system)** क्षेत्र  पर होने वाले विशिष्ट गतिविधियों के प्रतिरूप के लिए तैयार है। ***इसलिए, सही उत्तर I और II दोनों है।***

**Additional Information**

	**खो-खो का इतिहास**: इस खेल की शुरुआत भारत के **महाराष्ट्र** में हुई थी। औपचारिक नियमों का पहला समूह 1914 में पुणे के डेक्कन जिमखाना क्लब द्वारा तैयार किया गया था।
	**मैदान के आयाम (Dimensions)**: पुरुषों और महिलाओं के लिए एक मानक **खो-खो** कोर्ट की लंबाई **27 मीटर** और चौड़ाई **16 मीटर** होती है। इसमें केंद्रीय लेन के दोनों सिरों पर दो **पोल (poles)** होते हैं।
	**दल संरचना**: प्रत्येक दल  में **12 खिलाड़ी** होते हैं, लेकिन मैच के दौरान केवल **9 खिलाड़ी** ही मैदान पर उतरते हैं। खेल **पारी (innings)** में खेला जाता है, जिसमें पीछा करने (chasing) और बचाव करने (defending) की बारी शामिल होती है।
	**शारीरिक लाभ**: **खो-खो** का नियमित अभ्यास **हृदय सहनशक्ति (cardiovascular endurance)**, धड़ की मांसपेशियों की शक्ति और **मानसिक सतर्कता** को बढ़ाता है। यह पूरे **दक्षिण एशिया** के स्कूलों में व्यापक रूप से खेला जाता है।

**Important Points**

	विशिष्ट बनाम सामान्य प्रारम्भिक व्यायाम: जहाँ सामान्य प्रारम्भिक व्यायाम में शरीर का तापमान बढ़ाने के लिए हल्की दौड़ शामिल होती है, वहीं मेंढक छलाँग जैसा विशिष्ट प्रारम्भिक व्यायाम खेल में प्रयुक्त होने वाले विशेष मांसपेशी समूहों को तैयार करता है।
	**शब्दावली (Terminology)**: खेल के प्रमुख शब्दों में **चेज़र** (पीछा करने वाली टीम), **डिफेंडर** (जिस टीम का पीछा किया जा रहा है), खंभा गोता और **आकस्मिक मृत्यु** चरण शामिल हैं।
	**अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मान्यता**: खेल को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर बढ़ावा देने के लिए **1987** में **एशियाई खो-खो महासंघ (AKKF)** की स्थापना की गई थी, जिसके कारण इसे **दक्षिण एशियाई खेलों** में शामिल किया गया।
	**सुरक्षा**: टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी दौड़ जैसे व्यायाम शरीर की स्थिति का बोध ** (proprioception)** में भी मदद करते हैं, जो कि गति और स्थिति को महसूस करने की शरीर की क्षमता है, जिससे तेज गति से मुड़ने के दौरान **टखने की मोच (ankle sprains)** का खतरा कम हो जाता है।

questions.questionText: Around which fort did the city of Chennai develop?
questions.questionTextHi: चेन्नई शहर का विकास किस किले के चारों ओर हुआ था?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Fort Saint George**.

**Key Points**

**Fort Saint George** is historically recognized as the first **English fortress** in **India**, founded in **1644** in the coastal city of **Madras**, which is now known as **Chennai**.
The construction of the fort was initiated by the **British East India Company** through its agents, **Francis Day** and **Andrew Cogan**, who secured the grant of land from the local **Nayaka** rulers in **1639**.
The city of **Chennai** effectively developed and expanded around this fort, which served as a nucleus for **British** administrative and commercial activities in **South India** for centuries.
Historically, the settlement within the fort walls was referred to as **White Town**, while the indigenous settlements that grew outside the walls were known as **Black Town** (later renamed **George Town**).
Today, the fort continues to be a vital administrative hub, housing the **Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly** and the **Secretariat** of the **Government of Tamil Nadu**.

**Additional Information**

**Mehrangarh Fort**:

It is located in **Jodhpur**, **Rajasthan**, and is one of the largest and most magnificent forts in **India**.
Built around **1459** by **Rao Jodha**, the founder of **Jodhpur**, it sits on a perpendicular cliff, **410 feet** above the skyline of the city.

**Fort William**:

This fort is located in **Kolkata** (formerly **Calcutta**), **West Bengal**, on the eastern banks of the **Hooghly River**.
Named after **King William III**, the current structure was completed in **1781** following the **British** victory in the **Battle of Plassey** to prevent future attacks from **Bengal Nawabs**.

**Sindhudurg Fort**:

Located on the shore of **Malvan** in the **Konkan** region of **Maharashtra**, it is a powerful **sea fort**.
It was built by **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj** in **1664** to counter the rising influence of foreign colonial powers like the **English**, **Dutch**, and **Portuguese** and to defend the **Maratha Empire**.

**Important Points**

**St. Mary's Church**: Located inside **Fort Saint George**, it is the oldest **Anglican church** in **India**, consecrated in **1680**.
**Fort Museum**: The fort houses a museum that exhibits a large repository of weapons, uniforms, and artifacts from the **British** period, including the **first Indian Tricolour** hoisted at the fort after **Independence** on **August 15, 1947**.
**Geographical Context**: The city of **Chennai** is situated on the **Coromandel Coast** of the **Bay of Bengal**. It was renamed from **Madras** in the year **1996** by the state government.
**Architecture**: The fort walls were designed to withstand heavy **cannon fire**, reflecting the **military architecture** of the **17th century**.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **फोर्ट सेंट जॉर्ज** है।

**Key Points**

	**फोर्ट सेंट जॉर्ज** को ऐतिहासिक रूप से **भारत** में पहले **अंग्रेजी किले** के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है, जिसकी स्थापना **1644** में तटीय शहर **मद्रास** में की गई थी, जिसे अब **चेन्नई** के नाम से जाना जाता है।
	किले का निर्माण ब्रिटिश पूर्वी भारत कंपनी द्वारा उसके प्रतिनिधियों फ्रांसिस डे और एंड्रयू कोगन के माध्यम से प्रारम्भ किया गया था। इन दोनों ने 1639 में स्थानीय नायक शासकों से भूमि का अनुदान प्राप्त किया था।
	**चेन्नई** शहर का विकास और विस्तार प्रभावी रूप से इसी किले के चारों ओर हुआ, जिसने सदियों तक **दक्षिण भारत** में **ब्रिटिश** प्रशासनिक और व्यावसायिक गतिविधियों के केंद्र के रूप में कार्य किया।
	ऐतिहासिक रूप से, किले की दीवारों के भीतर की बस्ती को** श्वेत नगर **कहा जाता था, जबकि दीवारों के बाहर विकसित होने वाली स्वदेशी बस्तियों को **काला नगर **(बाद में इसका नाम बदलकर **जॉर्ज टाउन** कर दिया गया) के रूप में जाना जाता था।
	आज, यह किला एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक केंद्र बना हुआ है, जिसमें **तमिलनाडु विधानसभा** और **तमिलनाडु सरकार** का **सचिवालय** स्थित है।

**Additional Information**

	**मेहरानगढ़ किला**:

	
		यह **जोधपुर**, **राजस्थान** में स्थित है, और **भारत** के सबसे बड़े और सबसे भव्य किलों में से एक है।
		**जोधपुर** के संस्थापक **राव जोधा** द्वारा **1459** के आसपास निर्मित, यह किला शहर की क्षितिज रेखा से **410 फीट** ऊंची एक खड़ी चट्टान पर स्थित है।
	
	
	**फोर्ट विलियम**:
	
		यह किला **कोलकाता** (पूर्व में **कलकत्ता**), **पश्चिम बंगाल** में **हुगली नदी** के पूर्वी तट पर स्थित है।
		**किंग विलियम III** के नाम पर निर्मित, वर्तमान संरचना **1781** में **प्लासी की लड़ाई** में **ब्रिटिश** जीत के बाद पूरी हुई थी ताकि **बंगाल के नवाबों** द्वारा भविष्य में होने वाले हमलों को रोका जा सके।
	
	
	**सिंधुदुर्ग किला**:
	
		**महाराष्ट्र** के **कोंकण** क्षेत्र में **मालवन** के तट पर स्थित, यह एक शक्तिशाली **समुद्री किला** है।
		इसे **छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज** ने **1664** में **अंग्रेजों**, **डच** और **पुर्तगालियों** जैसी विदेशी औपनिवेशिक शक्तियों के बढ़ते प्रभाव का मुकाबला करने और **मराठा साम्राज्य** की रक्षा करने के लिए बनवाया था।
	
	

**Important Points**

	सेंट मैरी चर्च:** फोर्ट सेंट जॉर्ज के भीतर स्थित यह भारत का सबसे पुराना ऐंग्लिकन गिरजाघर** है, जिसका धार्मिक अभिषेक** वर्ष 1680** में किया गया था।
	**फोर्ट संग्रहालय**: किले में एक संग्रहालय है जो **ब्रिटिश** काल के हथियारों, वर्दी और कलाकृतियों के एक बड़े भंडार को प्रदर्शित करता है, जिसमें **15 अगस्त 1947** को **स्वतंत्रता** के बाद किले पर फहराया गया **पहला भारतीय तिरंगा** भी शामिल है।
	**भौगोलिक संदर्भ**: **चेन्नई** शहर **बंगाल की खाड़ी** के **कोरोमंडल तट** पर स्थित है। राज्य सरकार द्वारा वर्ष **1996** में इसका नाम **मद्रास** से बदलकर चेन्नई कर दिया गया था।
	**स्थापत्य कला**: किले की दीवारों को भारी **तोपों की गोलाबारी** को झेलने के लिए तैयार किया गया था, जो **17वीं शताब्दी** की **सैन्य वास्तुकला** को दर्शाता है।

questions.questionText: The advent of Purandaradasa, in the year ____, marked a very important landmark in the development of Carnatic music.
questions.questionTextHi: वर्ष ____ में पुरंदरदास के आगमन ने कर्नाटक संगीत के विकास में एक बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **1484**.

**Key Points**

The advent of **Purandaradasa** in the year **1484** marked a monumental shift in the evolution of **Carnatic music**, leading him to be revered as the **"Karnataka Sangeeta Pitamaha"** (the Grandfather of Carnatic Music).
Born as **Srinivasa Nayaka** in **Purandharagad** (near **Shimoga**, **Karnataka**), he was a wealthy diamond merchant before renouncing his worldly possessions to become a wandering devotee of **Lord Vitthala**.
He is credited with **systematizing the teaching methodology** of Carnatic music by introducing a graded syllabus that is still followed by students today, centuries later.
**Purandaradasa** introduced the raga **Mayamalavagowla** as the basic scale for music instruction. This choice was revolutionary because the scale’s symmetrical structure helps beginners grasp the nuances of **swaras** (notes) more effectively than other ragas.
He composed foundational exercises including **Svaravalis** (basic notes), **Janti Varisas** (double notes), **Alankaras** (rhythmic patterns), and **Geethams** (simple songs), which form the bedrock of **Carnatic vocal and instrumental training**.

**Additional Information**

**The Haridasa Movement:**

**Purandaradasa** was a prominent figure in the **Haridasa** movement of **Karnataka**, a devotional movement dedicated to **Lord Vishnu**.
He was a disciple of the great philosopher-saint **Vyasaraya**, who famously remarked that "Among the devotees, Purandara Dasa is the greatest."
The movement utilized **music and poetry** in the local **Kannada** language to spread **Bhakti** (devotion) and social reform among the common people.

**Composition and Style:**

His compositions are known as **Devaranamas** or **Dasapadas**. Legend suggests he composed **475,000** songs, though only about **1,000** are currently available.
He used the pen name (**Ankita Nama**) **'Purandara Vitthala'** at the end of each composition to signify his devotion.
His lyrics often dealt with **social issues**, criticizing caste discrimination, hypocrisy, and greed, while emphasizing the importance of an **inner spiritual life**.

**Influence on Later Musicians:**

The technical structure he established paved the way for the **"Trinity of Carnatic Music"** (**Tyagaraja**, **Muthuswami Dikshitar**, and **Syama Sastri**) who lived in the **18th century**.
**Saint Tyagaraja** openly acknowledged the influence of **Purandaradasa** in his own musical development and spiritual journey.

**Important Points**

**Historical Context:** **Purandaradasa** lived during the peak of the **Vijayanagara Empire**, particularly during the reign of **Krishnadevaraya**. This era was a **Golden Age** for art, culture, and literature in **South India**.
**Dates and Timeline:** While he was born in **1484**, he passed away in **1564**, just a year before the fall of the **Vijayanagara Empire** in the **Battle of Talikota** (**1565**).
**Cultural Impact:** His contribution transformed music from a complex courtly art into a medium of **mass spiritual expression**. By simplifying the language to **Kannada** and focusing on **rhythm and melody**, he made classical music accessible to all layers of society.
**Pedagogy:** Even today, every student of **Carnatic music** begins their journey by practicing the **Sarali Varisas** in **Raga Mayamalavagowla**, exactly as prescribed by **Purandaradasa** over **500 years ago**.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **1484** है।

**Key Points**

	वर्ष **1484** में **पुरंदरदास** के आगमन ने **कर्नाटक संगीत** के विकास में एक ऐतिहासिक परिवर्तन का सूत्रपात किया, जिसके कारण उन्हें **"कर्नाटक संगीत पितामह"** (कर्नाटक संगीत के दादा) के रूप में पूजा जाता है।
	**पुरंदरगढ़** (**शिमोगा**, **कर्नाटक** के पास) में **श्रीनिवास नायक** के रूप में जन्मे, वे एक समृद्ध हीरा व्यापारी थे, जिन्होंने अपनी सांसारिक संपत्ति का त्याग कर **भगवान विट्ठल** के एक घुमक्कड़ भक्त बन गए।
	उन्हें कर्नाटक संगीत की **शिक्षण पद्धति को व्यवस्थित करने** का श्रेय दिया जाता है, जिसके लिए उन्होंने एक श्रेणीबद्ध पाठ्यक्रम पेश किया जिसका पालन आज भी, सदियों बाद, छात्रों द्वारा किया जाता है।
	**पुरंदरदास** ने संगीत शिक्षण के लिए बुनियादी पैमाने के रूप में राग **मायामालवगौल** की शुरुआत की। यह चुनाव क्रांतिकारी था क्योंकि इस पैमाने की सममित संरचना शुरुआती लोगों को अन्य रागों की तुलना में **स्वरों** की बारीकियों को अधिक प्रभावी ढंग से समझने में मदद करती है।
	उन्होंने **स्वरवलिस** (बुनियादी स्वर), **जंती वरीसा** (दोहरे स्वर), **अलंकार** (लयबद्ध पैटर्न), और **गीतम** (सरल गीत) सहित बुनियादी अभ्यासों की रचना की, जो **कर्नाटक गायन और वाद्य प्रशिक्षण** का आधार हैं।

**Additional Information**

	**हरिदास आंदोलन:**

	
		**पुरंदरदास** **कर्नाटक** के **हरिदास** आंदोलन के एक प्रमुख व्यक्ति थे, जो **भगवान विष्णु** को समर्पित एक भक्ति आंदोलन था।
		वे महान दार्शनिक-संत **व्यासराय** के शिष्य थे, जिन्होंने प्रसिद्ध रूप से टिप्पणी की थी कि "भक्तों में, पुरंदर दास सबसे महान हैं।"
		इस आंदोलन ने आम लोगों के बीच **भक्ति** और सामाजिक सुधार फैलाने के लिए स्थानीय **कन्नड़** भाषा में **संगीत और कविता** का उपयोग किया।
	
	
	**रचना और शैली:**
	
		उनकी रचनाओं को **देवरनामा** या **दासपद** के रूप में जाना जाता है। किंवदंती बताती है कि उन्होंने **4,75,000** गीतों की रचना की थी, हालांकि वर्तमान में केवल **1,000** ही उपलब्ध हैं।
		उन्होंने अपनी भक्ति को दर्शाने के लिए प्रत्येक रचना के अंत में उपनाम (**अंकित नाम**) **'पुरंदर विट्ठल'** का उपयोग किया।
		उनके गीत अक्सर **सामाजिक मुद्दों** से निपटते थे, जातिगत भेदभाव, पाखंड और लालच की आलोचना करते थे, जबकि एक **आंतरिक आध्यात्मिक जीवन** के महत्व पर जोर देते थे।
	
	
	**परवर्ती संगीतकारों पर प्रभाव:**
	
		उनके द्वारा स्थापित तकनीकी संरचना ने **"कर्नाटक संगीत की त्रिमूर्ति"** (**त्यागराज**, **मुथुस्वामी दीक्षितर**, और **श्यामा शास्त्री**) के लिए मार्ग प्रशस्त किया, जो **18वीं शताब्दी** में जीवित थे।
		**संत त्यागराज** ने अपने स्वयं के संगीत विकास और आध्यात्मिक यात्रा में **पुरंदरदास** के प्रभाव को खुले तौर पर स्वीकार किया।
	
	

**Important Points**

	**ऐतिहासिक संदर्भ:** **पुरंदरदास** **विजयनगर साम्राज्य** के चरम काल में रहे, विशेष रूप से **कृष्णदेवराय** के शासनकाल के दौरान। यह युग **दक्षिण भारत** में कला, संस्कृति और साहित्य के लिए एक **स्वर्ण युग** था।
	**तिथियां और समयरेखा:** हालांकि उनका जन्म **1484** में हुआ था, लेकिन उनका निधन **1564** में हुआ, जो **तालीकोटा के युद्ध** (**1565**) में **विजयनगर साम्राज्य** के पतन से ठीक एक साल पहले था।
	**सांस्कृतिक प्रभाव:** उनके योगदान ने संगीत को एक जटिल दरबारी कला से **जन आध्यात्मिक अभिव्यक्ति** के माध्यम में बदल दिया। भाषा को **कन्नड़** में सरल बनाकर और **लय और माधुर्य** पर ध्यान केंद्रित करके, उन्होंने शास्त्रीय संगीत को समाज के सभी वर्गों के लिए सुलभ बना दिया।
	**शिक्षाशास्त्र:** आज भी, **कर्नाटक संगीत** का प्रत्येक छात्र **राग मायामालवगौल** में **सरली वरीसा** का अभ्यास करके अपनी यात्रा शुरू करता है, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे **500 वर्ष से अधिक पहले** **पुरंदरदास** द्वारा निर्धारित किया गया था।

questions.questionText: Who was India's first female Merchant Navy Captain?
questions.questionTextHi: भारत की पहली महिला मर्चेंट नेवी कैप्टन कौन थीं?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Radhika Menon**.

**Key Points**

**Radhika Menon** created history in **2012** by becoming the **first woman captain** in the **Indian Merchant Navy**.
She took command of the **MT Sampurna Swarajya**, an oil products tanker owned by the **Shipping Corporation of India (SCI)**.
She is a native of **Kodungallur** in **Kerala** and joined the **Shipping Corporation of India** as a **Radio Officer** in **1991**, gradually rising through the ranks.
In **2016**, she became the first woman in the world to receive the **IMO (International Maritime Organization) Award for Exceptional Bravery at Sea**.
This prestigious international award was bestowed upon her for leading a rescue operation in **June 2015**, where she saved **seven fishermen** from the sinking boat **'Durgamma'** that was caught in a storm in the **Bay of Bengal**.

**Additional Information**

**Reshma Nilofer Naha**:

She is the **first female marine pilot** in India.
Her role involves navigating large ships through the treacherous **Hooghly River** into the **Kolkata Port Trust** (now Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port).
Being a river pilot is considered one of the most challenging jobs in the maritime sector due to shifting sandbars and high tides.

**Aditi Pant**:

She is a renowned Indian **oceanographer** who was part of the **third Indian expedition** to **Antarctica** in **1983**.
Along with Sudipta Sengupta, she was one of the **first Indian women** to visit the frozen continent.

**Sheetal Devi**:

She is a world-renowned **Para-archer** from **Jammu and Kashmir**.
She is known for being the **first armless female archer** to compete internationally using her legs and feet.
She won two **gold medals** at the **2022 Asian Para Games** held in **Hangzhou**.

**Important Points**

The **Merchant Navy** is a commercial fleet that deals with the transportation of **cargo** and passengers across the sea. In India, it is regulated by the **Directorate General of Shipping** under the **Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways**.
The **International Maritime Organization (IMO)** is a specialized agency of the **United Nations** that sets global standards for the safety, security, and environmental performance of international shipping.
To support more women entering the maritime field, **Captain Radhika Menon** co-founded the **International Women Seafarers Foundation (IWSF)** in **2017**.
The **Shipping Corporation of India (SCI)**, established in **1961**, is the largest Indian shipping company and is a **Navratna** public sector enterprise.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **राधिका मेनन** है।

**Key Points**

	**राधिका मेनन** ने **2012** में **भारतीय मर्चेंट नेवी** में **पहली महिला कैप्टन** बनकर इतिहास रचा था।
	उन्होंने भारतीय नौवहन निगम (एससीआई) के स्वामित्व वाले तेल उत्पाद परिवहन पोत ‘एमटी संपूर्ण स्वराज’ की कमान संभाली थी।
	वह **केरल** के **कोदुंगल्लूर** की मूल निवासी हैं और **1991** में एक **रेडियो अधिकारी** के रूप में **भारतीय नौवहन निगम** में शामिल हुईं, और धीरे-धीरे इस पद तक पहुंचीं।
	**2016** में, वह समुद्र में असाधारण बहादुरी के लिए **IMO (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समुद्री संगठन) पुरस्कार** प्राप्त करने वाली दुनिया की पहली महिला बनीं।
	यह प्रतिष्ठित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार उन्हें **जून 2015** में एक बचाव अभियान का नेतृत्व करने के लिए प्रदान किया गया था, जहाँ उन्होंने **बंगाल की खाड़ी** में आए तूफान में डूबती नाव **'दुर्गाम्मा'** से **सात मछुआरों** को बचाया था।

**Additional Information**

	**रेशमा नीलोफर न्हा**:

	
		वह भारत की **पहली महिला मरीन पायलट** हैं।
		उनकी भूमिका में बड़े जहाजों को खतरनाक **हुगली नदी** के माध्यम से **कोलकाता पोर्ट ट्रस्ट** (अब श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी पोर्ट) में ले जाना शामिल है।
		स्थानांतरित होते रेत के बांधों और उच्च ज्वार के कारण नदी पायलट होना समुद्री क्षेत्र में सबसे चुनौतीपूर्ण नौकरियों में से एक माना जाता है।
	
	
	**अदिति पंत**:
	
		वह एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय **समुद्र विज्ञानी (oceanographer)** हैं, जो **1983** में **अंटार्कटिका** के लिए **तीसरे भारतीय अभियान** का हिस्सा थीं।
		सुदीप्ता सेनगुप्ता के साथ, वह जमे हुए महाद्वीप का दौरा करने वाली **पहली भारतीय महिलाओं** में से एक थीं।
	
	
	**शीतल देवी**:
	
		वह **जम्मू और कश्मीर** की एक विश्व प्रसिद्ध **पैरा-तीरंदाज** हैं।
		वह अपने पैरों और पंजों का उपयोग करके अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर प्रतिस्पर्धा करने वाली **पहली बिना हाथों वाली महिला तीरंदाज** के रूप में जानी जाती हैं।
		उन्होंने **हांग्जो** में आयोजित **2022 एशियाई पैरा खेलों** में दो **स्वर्ण पदक** जीते।
	
	

**Important Points**

	**मर्चेंट नेवी** एक वाणिज्यिक बेड़ा है जो समुद्र के माध्यम से **कार्गो (माल)** और यात्रियों के परिवहन का काम करता है। भारत में, इसे **पत्तन, पोत परिवहन और जलमार्ग मंत्रालय** के तहत **नौवहन महानिदेशालय** द्वारा विनियमित किया जाता है।
	**अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समुद्री संगठन (IMO)** **संयुक्त राष्ट्र** की एक विशेष संस्था है जो अंतर्राष्ट्रीय नौवहन की सुरक्षा, सुरक्षा और पर्यावरणीय प्रदर्शन के लिए वैश्विक मानक निर्धारित करती है।
	समुद्री क्षेत्र में अधिक महिलाओं के प्रवेश को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए कैप्टन राधिका मेनन ने वर्ष 2017 में अंतरराष्ट्रीय महिला नाविक प्रतिष्ठान (आईडब्ल्यूएसएफ) की सह-स्थापना की।
	**भारतीय नौवहन निगम** (एससीआई), जिसकी स्थापना वर्ष 1961 में हुई थी, भारत की सबसे बड़ी नौवहन कंपनी है और यह एक नवरत्न सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का उपक्रम है।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following idiom given in the alternatives has the meaning?
An overly elaborate or ostentatious presentation, event, or marketing display that, despite its flashy appearance, often lacks substance or real content.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **A dog and pony show**.

**Key Points**

The idiom **"A dog and pony show"** refers to an overly elaborate or ostentatious presentation, event, or marketing display that, despite its flashy appearance, often lacks substance or real content. (शोभा बढ़ाने वाला प्रदर्शन जो अक्सर असली सामग्री की कमी करता है)

**Example:** The product launch turned out to be a dog and pony show, with little actual information about the product itself.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Shanks's pony** (पैदल यात्रा): Refers to walking as a mode of transportation, especially when no other option is available.

**Example:** Since the bus broke down, we had to use Shanks's pony to reach home.

**One-trick pony** (सीमित प्रतिभा वाला): Refers to a person or thing that is known for only one special skill or attribute.

**Example:** The singer is a one-trick pony; she can only perform pop songs.

**Flog a dead pony** (बेकार प्रयास): Refers to wasting effort on a hopeless or futile cause.

**Example:** Trying to convince him to change his mind is like flogging a dead pony.

questions.questionText:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

Data centre developers warn that high **electircity** prices and **gridlock** in the energy network **threaten** the UK's **ability** to host AI infrastructure at scale.
questions.explanation:

**Key Points**

The given sentence contains a misspelled word: **electircity**.
The correct spelling of the word is **electricity**.
**Electricity** is a noun meaning 'a form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles.' **(विद्युत)**

**Correct sentence:** Data centre developers warn that high **electricity** prices and gridlock in the energy network threaten the UK's ability to host AI infrastructure at scale.

**Additional Information**

**Gridlock:** A situation where nothing can move forward due to a blockage or congestion. **(जाम)**
**Threaten:** To pose a danger or risk to something. **(धमकी देना)**

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "**delighted**".
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **3) Displeased**.

**Key Points**

The word **"delighted"** means feeling or showing great pleasure, happiness, or satisfaction. (प्रसन्न)

**Example:** She was delighted to receive a surprise gift on her birthday.

The word **"displeased"** is the opposite of "delighted" and refers to feeling annoyed or dissatisfied. (असंतुष्ट)

**Example:** He was displeased with the delay in the delivery of his order.

Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"delighted"** is **"displeased"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Displeased**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Elated** (उत्साहित): Extremely happy or joyful.

**Example:** She felt elated after winning the competition.

**Jubilant** (प्रफुल्लित): Feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph.

**Example:** The team was jubilant after their victory in the finals.

**Overjoyed** (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): Feeling great joy or happiness.

**Example:** He was overjoyed to see his family after a long time.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Grabbed**.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Release**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Grabbed"** refers to the act of taking or seizing something suddenly or forcibly. (पकड़ा)

**Example:** He grabbed the book from the shelf before anyone else could reach it.

**"Release"** means to let go or set free something that was previously held or restrained. (छोड़ना)

**Example:** She released the bird from the cage and watched it fly away.

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Grabbed"** is **"Release"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Release**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Snatched** (झपटा): To take something quickly or forcibly.

**Example:** She snatched the phone from his hand before he could respond.

**Seized** (जब्त किया): To take hold of something forcefully or possessively.

**Example:** The police seized the illegal items during the raid.

**Clutched** (जकड़ना): To hold something tightly.

**Example:** She clutched her purse tightly as she walked through the crowded market.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence where the homonym "date" means a fruit.

options.text: He asked her out on a dinner date.
The date on the coin is from 1947.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "We bought a box of sweet dates from the market".

**Key Points**

The word **"date"** has multiple meanings (homonym). In this context, "date" refers to the fruit that grows on a date palm tree. (खजूर)

**Example:** Dates are rich in nutrients and often used as a natural sweetener.

The correct usage is "We bought a box of sweet dates from the market," where "date" specifically refers to the fruit (खजूर).

**Example:** I enjoy eating dates for breakfast as they provide quick energy.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
A person who lives only for pleasure.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Hedonist**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Hedonist"** refers to a person who lives only for pleasure and prioritizes enjoyment over all else. (आनंदवादी)

**Example:** A hedonist often seeks out luxurious vacations and indulges in extravagant experiences.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?
They will announce the results tomorrow.

options.text: The results will be announced tomorrow.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
In the active voice, the sentence is: "They will announce the results tomorrow."
To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the results" at the beginning of the sentence.
Change the active verb form "will announce" to "will be announced" (future simple passive).
Ensure the time phrase "tomorrow" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The results will be announced tomorrow."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: **"The results are announced tomorrow." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive instead of future simple passive).
**Option 2: **"The results will announced tomorrow." – Grammatically incorrect (missing "be" in the passive structure).
**Option 4: **"The results were announced tomorrow." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive instead of future simple passive).

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Do water birds lay eggs in water or on land?

options.text: Are eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?
Do eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?
Did eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?
Is eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

The given sentence is a question in the active voice: "Do water birds lay eggs in water or on land?"
To convert it into the passive voice, the object of the active sentence ("eggs") becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
The auxiliary verb "do" is replaced with "are" to match the plural subject "eggs" in the passive structure.
The main verb "lay" is changed to its past participle form "laid" in the passive voice.
The rest of the sentence structure remains the same to retain its meaning.

Therefore, the correct passive voice sentence is: **Option 1: "Are eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?"**

**Correct Sentence:** *"Are eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?"*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2:** "Do eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?" – Incorrect because the auxiliary verb "do" is not used in the passive voice structure.
**Option 3:** "Did eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?" – Incorrect because "did" changes the tense to the past, which is not consistent with the original sentence.
**Option 4:** "Is eggs laid by water birds in water or on land?" – Incorrect because the singular auxiliary verb "is" does not match the plural subject "eggs."

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Was the speech delivered by the prime minister at the international summit?

options.text: Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?
Has the prime minister delivered the speech at the international summit?
Is the prime minister delivering the speech at the international summit?
Will the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, and the task is to convert it into the **active voice**.
In the passive voice sentence, "Was the speech delivered by the prime minister at the international summit?" the subject is "the speech" and the doer of the action is "the prime minister."
To convert this into the active voice:

Start with the doer of the action, i.e., "the prime minister."
Use the correct verb form. In this case, "Was delivered" (passive) changes to "Did deliver" (active, past tense).
Maintain the additional details of the sentence, i.e., "the speech at the international summit."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?"*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1:** "Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?" – **Correct**. This is the active voice version of the given passive voice sentence.
**Option 2:** "Has the prime minister delivered the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to present perfect.
**Option 3:** "Is the prime minister delivering the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to present continuous.
**Option 4:** "Will the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to future simple.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

When were these pamphlets being distributed?

options.text: When were they distributing these pamphlets?
When are they distributing these pamphlets?
When will they distribute these pamphlets?
When were the distribution of pamphlets happening?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

The given sentence is in the **passive voice**.
The structure of the passive voice for past continuous tense is: **was/were + being + past participle.**
To convert this into the active voice, identify the subject performing the action. In this case, the subject is "**they**."
The active voice structure for past continuous tense is: **Subject + was/were + base verb (-ing) + object.**
By applying this structure, the sentence becomes: **"When were they distributing these pamphlets?"**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"When were they distributing these pamphlets?"*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2: **"When are they distributing these pamphlets?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of past continuous).
**Option 3: **"When will they distribute these pamphlets?" – Incorrect tense (future simple instead of past continuous).
**Option 4: **"When were the distribution of pamphlets happening?" – Grammatically incorrect and awkward construction.

questions.questionText:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

In their study, they tried to find out the relationship among an organism, its habitat, and the predators present there.

options.text: In their study, they tried to

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

The error lies in the usage of the preposition "**among**" in part C.
While "among" is often used for three or more items, "**between**" is the correct choice when referring to distinct, individual relationships between specific, named entities.
In this context, the study examines the specific relationship connecting three distinct items: **an organism**, **its habitat**, and **the predators**.
Therefore, "among" should be replaced with "**between**" to accurately describe the correlation between these specific variables.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"In their study, they tried to find out the relationship **between** an organism, its habitat, and the predators present there."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "In their study, they tried to"** – This part is grammatically sound, using the correct past tense and infinitive structure.
**Option 2: "find out the relationship"** – This phrase is standard English and correctly identifies the objective of the study.
**Option 4: "and the predators present there."** – This part is correct; "present there" functions as a postpositive adjective modifying "predators."
**Usage Tip:** Use "between" for distinct items (e.g., between X, Y, and Z) and "among" for items viewed as a group or mass (e.g., among the crowd).

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

They are cutting down trees ________ the tune of 1000 tons a month.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**to**'.

**Key Points**

The preposition "**to**" is used to describe a measurement or extent in this context ("**to the tune of**").
The phrase "**to the tune of**" means "amounting to" or "in the magnitude of."
Options **on**, **of**, and **by** do not convey the correct meaning in this specific phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"They are cutting down trees **to** the tune of 1000 tons a month."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "on"** is incorrect because it does not fit the idiomatic phrase "to the tune of."
**Option 2: "of"** is incorrect because it does not convey the intended measurement or magnitude.
**Option 3: "by"** is incorrect because it does not align with the idiomatic usage of the phrase.

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: “No improvement required.”

She enjoys hiking in the mountains, swimming in the ocean, and to ride her bike in the park every weekend.

options.text: and ride her bike in the park
and to ride her bike around the park
and riding her bike in the park

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**3**'.

The sentence lists parallel activities: hiking, swimming, and biking.
Parallel structure requires all items in a list to follow the same grammatical form.
In this case, the gerund form (verb + "ing") is correct for maintaining consistency.

questions.questionText:
Identify the voice of the sentence.

"Scammers design fake job postings to exploit job seekers."
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

**Active Voice structure:** In an active voice sentence, the subject is the "doer" of the action. The basic formula is: **Subject + Verb + Object.**
In the sentence: *"Scammers design fake job postings to exploit job seekers."*
**Subject:** "Scammers" (The entity performing the action).
**Verb:** "design" (The action being performed).
**Object:** "fake job postings" (The entity receiving the action).
Since the subject ("Scammers") is directly performing the action of "designing," the sentence is in the **Active Voice**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Active Sentence:** *"Scammers design fake job postings to exploit job seekers."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2: Passive Voice** – In the passive voice, the object becomes the subject: *"Fake job postings **are designed** by scammers to exploit job seekers."*
**Option 3: Reflexive Voice** – This occurs when the subject and the object are the same person or thing (e.g., *"The scammers **disguised themselves**."*).
**Option 4: Causative Voice** – This indicates that the subject causes someone else to do something (e.g., *"The leader **had the scammers design** fake postings."*).

questions.questionText: In the sentence "Scammers masquerade as hiring managers offering attractive jobs," what is the part of speech of the word "masquerade"?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e '**Verb**'.

**Key Points**

The word **"masquerade"** in the sentence is a verb.
**Verbs** express actions, occurrences, or states of being. In the sentence, "masquerade" describes the action that the scammers are performing.
The word **"masquerade"** indicates the specific action of pretending or disguising that the scammers are undertaking.
**Verbs** are essential in sentences as they provide the main action or state around which the sentence is structured.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **Option 2.**

**Additional Information**

**Noun:** A **noun** is a person, place, thing, or idea. "Masquerade" can be a noun in other contexts, but in this sentence, it functions as a verb.
**Adjective:** An **adjective** modifies or describes a noun or pronoun. "Masquerade" does not describe a noun in this sentence.
**Adverb:** An **adverb** modifies a verb, adjective, or other adverb. "Masquerade" is itself a verb and is not modifying another word in this sentence.

questions.questionText: **What are the main types of frauds related to job applications mentioned in the passage, and how do they affect job seekers?**

options.text: Fake job postings and false promises, causing financial loss and identity theft.
Government job alerts and verified recruitment, ensuring job security.
Real job offers with transparent processes, helping job seekers find employment.
Online training programs providing free certifications to all applicants.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Key Points**

***Methods of Deception.***

The passage identifies several deceptive methods, such as designing fake job postings, impersonating recruiters, and conducting sham interviews via messaging apps to extract personal information.

***Specific Types of Fraud.***

Common scams mentioned include fake staffing agencies requesting upfront payments, money laundering schemes using victims' bank accounts, and charging fees for fabricated credit report checks.

***Consequences for Job Seekers.***

These fraudulent activities lead to significant negative outcomes, specifically causing financial loss, exposing victims to identity theft, and potentially creating legal complications.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Additional Information**

**Option 2**: Incorrect because government alerts are mentioned as a response to scams (awareness campaigns), not as a type of fraud, and the passage focuses on the lack of security caused by scams.
**Option 3**: Incorrect because the passage highlights "fake job postings" and "deceptive practices," which are the opposite of real, transparent job offers.
**Option 4**: Incorrect because the passage states that scammers often "request payment" for training or processing fees, rather than providing free certifications.
